name: Austin Trail of Lights
description: The Austin Trail of Lights site lists December 10–23, 2026, 7:00–10:00 p.m., at Zilker Park, 2100 Barton Springs Rd. General admission is free on December 10, 11, and 13–17. On December 12 and 18–23 it is $8 for ages 12 and older, and free for children under 12. ZIP and Platinum passes are separate tickets.
